title: Self-Parking Saving for Ashbury Rewards Co-brand Cardmembers on Guest Folios
content:
Holders of the Ashbury Rewards co-brand credit cards receive an extra parking saving on the self-parking of their stays on Guest Folios.

**Term.** Card parking saving: a membership linked to the Ashbury Rewards Premier Card adds the premier card saving percent of 3 percentage points, one linked to the Ashbury Rewards Card adds the rewards card saving percent of 2 percentage points, and one with no linked card adds nothing. The points are added into the stay's self-parking saving percent before that percentage is applied to the self-parking charged, never applied separately one after another.

The linked card is the co-brand card shown on the Ashbury Rewards membership credited for the stay, as reported by the issuing bank.

| Co-brand card on the Ashbury Rewards membership | Percentage points added |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier Card | 3 |
| Ashbury Rewards Card | 2 |
| No linked card | None |

## Cardmember questions

**How do the card's points enter the saving?** The 3 or 2 percentage points are summed into the saving percent itself, and the resulting single percentage is applied once to the self-parking charged.

**Hypothetical figures.** Taking a hypothetical saving percent of 5% before the card points, on $150.00 of self-parking a Premier Cardmember's 8% (5% plus 3 points) is $12.00, and an Ashbury Rewards Cardmember's 7% (5% plus 2 points) is $10.50.

**Does the card saving depend on the tier?** No; it follows the linked card alone.
